en.name: Soy milk
en.summary: Soy milk is ground soaked soybeans cooked and strained into a drink, sold chilled or in shelf-stable cartons. Keep it refrigerated and follow the use-by date on an unopened pack; once opened, use it within 7–10 days.
en.pantry: An unopened aseptic carton keeps in a cool cupboard to its printed date, because it was sterilised and filled sealed. Chilled cartons must stay cold — follow the 2-hour rule, or 1 hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Once opened, neither belongs in a cupboard. Freshly made soy milk from a breakfast shop or a home machine is a different thing again: it is a warm, low-acid, protein-rich liquid with no preservative, it sours within hours at room temperature, and it should be chilled fast and drunk the same day.
en.fridge: Keep soy milk at 4 °C (40 °F) or below on an inside shelf rather than the door. Unopened chilled cartons run to the use-by date on the package. After opening, use it within 7–10 days with the cap closed and the carton upright. Soy milk separates and forms a skin as it stands, both of which are normal; shake it before pouring. It curdles in coffee for a reason unrelated to spoilage — the acidity and heat of the coffee destabilise the soy protein — so a curdled latte is not proof that the carton has turned.
en.freezer: There is no published freezer timeline for soy milk, and freezing separates it: the protein and fat come out of suspension and the thawed drink is grainy and watery in a way that shaking will not fully fix. If you have to, freeze it at −18 °C (0 °F) in a container with headspace and use it in cooking, baking or a smoothie. It is better to buy a size you will finish, or to make less at a time.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, never on the counter, and blend or shake hard. Use it in cooking rather than drinking it straight, and do not refreeze.
spoilage: A sour, sharp or yeasty smell instead of a clean beany one.
Lumps or curdled strands in the carton that do not shake out.
A swollen carton, or a fizz and hiss on opening.
A slimy, ropy pour, or mould around the spout.
tips: Write the opening date on the carton.
Shake before every pour; separation and a skin are normal.
Never drink from the carton if you are keeping the rest.
Drink freshly made soy milk the same day and chill it fast.

faq.q: How long does soy milk last after opening?
faq.a: About 7–10 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, kept closed and upright.

faq.q: Does soy milk need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Chilled cartons do, and unopened ones go by the use-by date. Aseptic shelf-stable cartons can stay in the cupboard until opened.
There is no established timeline. It separates badly, so freeze it only for cooking or baking, at −18 °C with headspace in the container.

faq.q: Why does soy milk curdle in coffee?
faq.a: The acidity and heat of the coffee destabilise the soy protein. It is a chemistry problem, not a sign that the milk has gone off.

zh.name: 豆漿
zh.summary: 豆漿是黃豆泡軟磨碎、煮熟過濾而成的飲品，市面上有冷藏與常溫利樂包兩種。請冷藏保存，未開封以包裝有效日期為準；開封後請在 7～10 天內喝完。
zh.pantry: 未開封的無菌利樂包可以放陰涼櫥櫃到標示日期，因為它經過滅菌並密封充填。冷藏包裝則必須保冷——請守 2 小時原則（廚房超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時）。一旦開封，兩種都不能放櫥櫃。早餐店或豆漿機現做的又是另一回事：那是溫熱、低酸、蛋白質豐富又完全沒有防腐的液體，在室溫下幾個小時就會發酸，必須迅速降溫並當天喝完。
zh.fridge: 放在 4 °C 以下的內側層架，不要放門邊。未開封的冷藏包裝以有效日期為準。開封後請在 7～10 天內喝完，蓋子關緊、盒身直立。豆漿靜置會分層、表面也會結一層皮，兩者都正常，倒之前搖勻即可。它在咖啡裡結絮的原因和變質無關——是咖啡的酸度和溫度讓大豆蛋白失去穩定——所以拿鐵結絮並不代表那盒豆漿壞了。
zh.freezer: 豆漿沒有公告的冷凍期限，而且冷凍會讓它分離：蛋白質和油脂脫離懸浮狀態，解凍後又粗又水，搖也搖不回來。真的要凍，請放 −18 °C、容器留膨脹空間，之後用於料理、烘焙或果昔。比較好的做法是買喝得完的容量，或一次少做一點。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，不要放室溫，之後用力搖勻或打勻。建議用於料理而不是直接喝，也不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸、刺鼻或有酵母味，而不是乾淨的豆香。
盒內出現搖不散的結塊或凝絮。
包裝鼓脹，或開封時冒泡、有嘶聲。
倒出來黏稠牽絲，或吸嘴周圍長霉。
tips: 每次倒之前搖一搖；分層和結皮都是正常的。
還要留著喝的話，不要直接對著盒口喝。
現做豆漿請快速降溫並當天喝完。

faq.q: 豆漿開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 蓋緊直立放 4 °C 以下，大約 7～10 天。
冷藏包裝一定要，未開封以有效日期為準。無菌常溫利樂包在開封前可放櫥櫃。
沒有既定期限。它分離得厲害，只建議冷凍後用於料理或烘焙，放 −18 °C 並留膨脹空間。

faq.q: 豆漿加咖啡為什麼會結絮？
faq.a: 咖啡的酸度和溫度讓大豆蛋白失去穩定。那是化學問題，不代表豆漿壞掉。
